prompt: Create a landing page for a new SaaS product called "FlowNote". It should have a hero section, a features section, and a form where visitors enter their email to join the waitlist. Save the emails so I can see who signed up.

followUps.q: Since you want to save signups, I'll set up a database to persist the emails.
How should the page where you view waitlist signups be protected?
The admin page needs a password environment variable. Let me prompt you to set it, then verify everything in the browser.
Want me to add password protection to the admin page, or adjust any of the copy or visuals?
